diagnostics.message: `:resource.google_org_policy_policy.default` creates org policy overrides scoped to `projects/${local.project.project_id}`, so it can only be applied once the project exists, yet it has no dependency on `:resource.google_project.project` (and every other resource in the module — services, IAM, sinks — is ordered behind it). A project created in the same apply may not exist yet when the policy is applied.

`:resource.google_project_iam_custom_role.roles` creates custom roles inside the project (`project = local.project.project_id`), but has no dependency at all on `:resource.google_project.project`, so it can race with project creation when the module creates the project itself.

`:resource.google_resource_manager_lien.lien` sets `parent = "projects/${local.project.number}"`; the project number only exists after `:resource.google_project.project` is created, but the lien has no edge to it, so the lien can be created before (or fail while) the project is provisioned.

`:resource.google_tags_tag_key.default` creates project-scoped tag keys with `parent = "projects/${local.project.project_id}"`, but nothing orders it after `:resource.google_project.project`; on a freshly created project it can be applied before the project exists.

`:resource.google_tags_tag_binding.binding` binds tag values to `//cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/projects/${local.project.number}` — the binding cannot be created until `:resource.google_project.project` exists and has a project number, yet the graph shows no dependency on it.

`:resource.google_access_context_manager_service_perimeter_resource.default` adds `projects/${local.project.number}` to a VPC-SC perimeter; the project must exist (and be readable) first, but this resource has no dependency on `:resource.google_project.project`, so it can be applied before the project is created.

`:resource.google_access_context_manager_service_perimeter_dry_run_resource.default` adds `projects/${local.project.number}` to a VPC-SC dry-run perimeter and likewise has no dependency on `:resource.google_project.project`, so it can run before the project exists.

`:resource.google_monitoring_monitored_project.primary` registers `local.project.project_id` into each metrics-scope project; the project must already exist and be visible to the monitoring API, but the graph shows no dependency on `:resource.google_project.project`, so registration can race with project creation.
